abstract: Network Solutions is easy for beginners and slower than most rivals. Renewal is about three times the promo price on Starter.

citation.name: HostingAdvice: Network Solutions review (Nov 2026, 3 weeks of testing)

name: Jamil Ahmed
description: Founder and CEO of Reinforce Lab. Pharmacist, SEO and AI search consultant, and Semrush Ambassador.

mainEntity.name: Is Network Solutions good for hosting?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is easy for beginners. HostingAdvice found speed a bit below average and no CDN.

mainEntity.name: How much does Network Solutions hosting cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Starter is $2.99 a month at the promo price and $8.83 a month at renewal.
HostingAdvice measured grade B on the cheap plan, grade C on the WordPress plan and grade A on the eCommerce plan.

mainEntity.name: Does Network Solutions have a money-back guarantee?

acceptedAnswer.text: We did not find one on the hosting page.

mainEntity.name: Does Network Solutions have a Black Friday deal?

acceptedAnswer.text: Its blog lists SITEWIDE30 for 30% off an AI All-Access Pack from 23 November to 7 December 2026. It is not a hosting discount.
